visual_name: Day in the life, part thirty: the cancel button (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js rooftop parking deck (parking lines, parapet walls, a lamp post, block-built parked cars, a city skyline), a box-built hatchback with the driver door swung open, slanted windshield, dashboard, steering wheel, a phone in a dash mount with renewal banners on its lock screen, a seat back that drops flat, box-built creator in a backwards cap and denim jacket, phone sheets for subscriptions / renewal emails / YourBrand creator tools / YourBrand menu / a teleprompter app's account page, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 37.5 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: in his parked car on a rooftop deck, a creator pays for four apps to make one video (a teleprompter, a hashtag app, a script writer, a pitch writer). Four renewal emails in a row; the apps made more from his video than he did, and his seat drops flat. Then YourBrand: the tools are already in it (scripts, hashtags, pitch templates), in the same menu as his campaigns. He cancels three apps. He still pays for the teleprompter: he can't find the cancel button.
